commands.command:
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e

SRC_HOST="node2"
SRC_IP="10.100.131.11"
SRC_PATH="/srv/inventory/data"
DEST_DIR="/var/backups/inventory"
RETAIN_DAYS=7
DATE="$(date +%Y-%m-%d)"
ARCHIVE="$DEST_DIR/inventory-$DATE.tar.gz"
LOG="/var/log/inventory-backup.log"

mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

echo "$(date -Iseconds) starting backup of $SRC_HOST:$SRC_PATH -> $ARCHIVE" >> "$LOG"

TMPDIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT

ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new "root@${SRC_IP}" \
    "tar -C $(dirname "$SRC_PATH") -cf - $(basename "$SRC_PATH")" > "$TMPDIR/data.tar"

mkdir -p "$TMPDIR/extract"
tar -C "$TMPDIR/extract" -xf "$TMPDIR/data.tar"

tar -C "$TMPDIR/extract" -czf "$ARCHIVE" "$(basename "$SRC_PATH")"

echo "$(date -Iseconds) archive created: $ARCHIVE ($(stat -c %s "$ARCHIVE") bytes)" >> "$LOG"

find "$DEST_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -mtime "+$((RETAIN_DAYS - 1))" -print -delete >> "$LOG" 2>&1

echo "$(date -Iseconds) backup complete, retained files:" >> "$LOG"
ls -1 "$DEST_DIR" >> "$LOG"
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh | head -5
